author: Hugh Howey
notes: Hugh Howey’s 'Wool' is a dystopian sci-fi novel set in a post-apocalyptic world where humanity survives in an underground silo, exploring themes of control, rebellion, and truth through a gripping mystery. Apple TV+’s series adaptation has been a major talking point for genre fans, with its high production values and a stellar cast led by Rebecca Ferguson and Tim Robbins. Directed by Morten Tyldum, known for cerebral thrillers, the show is in post-production with a confirmed late 2026 premiere. This project stands out for its ambitious world-building, aiming to rival other prestige sci-fi series. I strongly advise reading 'Wool' first—its detailed setting and slow-burn suspense are best experienced in the novel, and knowing the story will enhance appreciation of the visual translation.
